Select the first 200 metabolism records for enzyme UGT1A9. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id, then to compound_structures on molregno to obtain canonical_smiles and substrate_compound_name. Optionally join molecule_hierarchy from the substrate molregno to retrieve parent_compound_name. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Do not sort; preserve source row order.
